papers.title: The low-value trap: Sustaining multi-actor collaboration across problem spaces in emerging technology commercialization
papers.abstract: Despite the potential applications of bio-marine technologies, many promising innovations remain confined to the laboratory, missing potential high-value applications and damaging the overall perception of the emerging technology. Prior research has highlighted the positive impact of multi-actor collaborations on technology development, particularly to bridge the gap between the lab and the market. However, we know little about the mechanisms that sustain productive multi-actor collaboration in emerging technology commercialization and why they prove insufficient as actors move from low-to high-value applications. We study the case of an emerging technology – the utilization and application of fucoidan, a bio-marine extract – to explore how collaboration is sustained among actors as they face the increasing complexity of the technology commercialization for high-value applications. By building on patents and publications and analyzing in-depth interviews, we identify three key mechanisms that support effective collaboration: anchoring a shared vision, coordinating across knowledge boundaries, and structuring an operational framework. We show how these mechanisms need to be recalibrated, not simply scaled, when actors transition across problem spaces from low to high-value applications, and why the failure to do so produces a low-value trap for the emerging technology.
papers.summary_ja: 新興技術の事業化において多アクター協働が低価値応用に固着する「低価値トラップ」のメカニズムを解明し、高価値領域への移行には共有ビジョンの再構築・知識境界を越えた調整・運用フレームワークの再キャリブレーションという3メカニズムが単なるスケールアップでなく「再調整」を必要とすることを示す。

papers.title: AI maturity and firm performance: integrating organizational, technological and business model dimensions
papers.abstract: This study develops and validates an artificial intelligence (AI) maturity construct grounded in dynamic capabilities theory, conceptualizing AI maturity as a reflective construct shaped by three antecedents: organizational readiness (OR), technological deployment (TD) and business model innovation (BMI). Business model innovation emerged as the strongest antecedent of AI maturity, followed by organizational readiness and technological deployment. AI maturity significantly enhances perceived AI-enabled performance outcomes – operational efficiency, market performance and financial stability. Survey data from 132 small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) across multiple industries in South Korea are analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling (SmartPLS 4).
papers.summary_ja: AI成熟度を動的ケイパビリティ論で概念化し、韓国SME 132社のPLS-SEM分析により「ビジネスモデルイノベーション（BMI）→AI成熟度→業績」という戦略先行型の因果連鎖を実証した。BMIがテクノロジー導入よりも強力なAI成熟度の先行要因である。

papers.title: Assessing the role of collaborative innovation in industry-education integration and economic development
papers.abstract: Collaborative Innovation (CI) activities help educational institutions work with industries while driving industrial progress and the Chinese economy. In emerging economies, it becomes a struggle to understand the partnerships and collaborative methods that lead to workforce talent, industrial growth, and economic development outcomes. The research creates a basic structural framework that connects CI to achieve industrial transformation and economic progress. A mixed-methods approach is employed through collecting surveys from 622 participants and interviews from 102 participants. Findings indicate that industry-education integration strongly drives enterprise collaboration (β = 0.629), talent development (β = 0.592), which leads to industrial upgradation (β = 0.421), and economic development (β = 0.671).
papers.summary_ja: 産学連携に基づく協働イノベーション（CI）が企業協働・人材育成・産業高度化・経済発展に与える影響を、622人のサーベイと102人のインタビューを用いた混合手法で実証した。産学政三者エコシステム型のCIが最も高い経済成果を生む。

papers.title: Online Versus Face-to-Face Multiparty Interactions: Effects on Emergent System Dynamics and Integrative Outcomes
papers.abstract: Multiparty systems address wicked problems by bringing together stakeholders with diverse and sometimes competing interests. Although previous research has emphasized the role of expected positive interdependence in driving system-level dynamics and reaching integrative negotiations, the impact of the communication environment (online versus face-to-face) on the effect of expectations has not been sufficiently investigated. We used a behavioural multiparty simulation task (26 simulations, 130 groups, 441 participants) in which five stakeholder groups were invited to address a complex regional development problem. We find support for the role of expectations in driving the experience of positive interdependence, but not overall system dynamics.
papers.summary_ja: 「Wicked Problem」に取り組む多者間システムにおいて、オンラインvs対面のコミュニケーション環境が創発的なシステムダイナミクスと統合的合意形成に与える影響を441名の行動実験で検証した。期待の役割は確認されたが、環境の違いがシステム全体のダイナミクスに与える影響は限定的であった。

papers.title: Toward strategic harmony between codification and personalisation in services firms
papers.abstract: The increasing impact of digitization and the evolution of information and communication technologies have significant knowledge implications for productivity and innovation in service firms. Understanding the harmony between codification and personalization of knowledge is crucial for executives managing strategic knowledge in knowledge-based firms. This study focuses on the advisory services sector, where knowledge is considered a valuable strategic asset. The research employed a qualitative approach with multiple case studies.
papers.summary_ja: デジタル化が進む知識集約型サービス企業において、知識の「コード化戦略」と「個人化戦略」の戦略的調和がいかに生産性とイノベーションに貢献するかを、アドバイザリー企業の複数ケース研究で考察した。

papers.title: Digital business strategy and platform risk as determinants of knowledge strategy in SMEs
papers.abstract: This study investigates the ways in which digital business strategies (DBS) impact strategic competitive performance and product innovation in SMEs. Employing the resource-based approach, the study investigates the fundamental processes by which these tactics produce results. Data from 481 Chinese enterprises was acquired, and structural equation modeling was used for analysis. Findings indicate that a DBS positively influences knowledge digitization but does not significantly impact digital knowledge transfer management. Knowledge digitization mediates the relationship between DBS and both strategic competitive and product innovation performance. Furthermore, digital platform risk is found to dampen the effect of DBS on knowledge digitization.
papers.summary_ja: デジタルビジネス戦略（DBS）が知識デジタル化を通じて競争力と製品イノベーションを高める一方、プラットフォームリスクがDBSの効果を抑制することを、中国481社のSEM分析で実証した。戦略―知識デジタル化―パフォーマンスの連鎖メカニズムを解明。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Embedding and Enterprise Competitiveness in the Embodied Intelligence Industry: The Mediating Role of Competitive Structure Reconfiguration
papers.abstract: This study examines how AI embedding affects enterprise competitiveness in China's embodied intelligence industry and whether competitive structure reconfiguration mediates this relationship. Using survey data from 266 firms and partial least squares structural equation modeling, the analysis shows that AI embedding positively affects both enterprise competitiveness and competitive structure reconfiguration. Competitive structure reconfiguration also improves enterprise competitiveness and partially mediates the focal relationship, with a variance accounted for value of 43.7%.
papers.summary_ja: AIの組織・製品・生態系への「埋め込み」（AI embedding）が競争構造の再構成を媒介して企業競争力を高めることを、中国のembodied intelligence産業266社のデータで実証した。AI採用よりもAI統合の深度が競争優位の鍵。

papers.title: Translating front-end supplier involvement orientation into firm innovation capability: The mediating role of outward-looking organizational practices
papers.abstract: Our aim is to investigate the consequent effects of orienting towards supplier involvement in the fuzzy front end (FFE), as well as purchasing and supply management (PSM) practices, on a focal firm's innovation capability. We drew on the capability-based transactions theory. Data from 206 automotive firms and structural equation modeling (SEM) show that supplier involvement orientation in the FFE has a stronger positive impact on incremental innovation capability. Cooperation with non-value-chain partners supports both radical and incremental innovation.
papers.summary_ja: 新製品開発のファジーフロントエンド（FFE）におけるサプライヤー関与の志向性が、外部志向の組織慣行を媒介して企業の漸進的・根本的イノベーション能力を高めることを、自動車206社のSEM分析で示す。B2Bイノベーション推進の組織設計に示唆。

papers.title: Why stay connected? Understanding customer transitions in the modern energy landscape
papers.abstract: The rapid adoption of distributed energy technologies (DET) such as rooftop solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and electric vehicles (EVs) is transforming the structure of power systems and the role of customers within them. Traditionally, electricity customers were passive consumers fully dependent on the supply of the centralized grid. However, the integration of DET at the household level enables customers to generate, store, and manage electricity.
papers.summary_ja: 分散型エネルギー技術（太陽光・蓄電池・EVなど）の普及によって「受動的消費者」から「エネルギー生産消費者（prosumer）」へと変容する顧客行動を分析し、グリッド接続継続の動機とサービスデザイン上の示唆を考察する。

papers.title: Entrepreneurial intentions among medical doctors in a research-led hospital: The role of perceived organizational support for innovation and individual collaboration propensity
papers.journal: International Journal of Entrepreneurial Behaviour & Research
papers.abstract: Drawing on the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), this study investigates the relationship between medical doctors' entrepreneurial attitude (EA) and their entrepreneurial intentions (EI). By integrating considerations from Corporate Entrepreneurship (CE) and the Social Capital (SC) theory, this paper aims to understand whether and how MDs' perceived organizational support for innovation (POSI) and individual collaboration propensity (CP) influence the relationship in a research-led hospital.
papers.summary_ja: 計画行動理論・コーポレートアントレプレナーシップ・社会関係資本論を統合し、医療専門職における「組織的イノベーション支援の知覚（POSI）」と「個人の協働志向」が起業家的意図に与える影響を検討した。高度専門職組織での内部起業家精神育成に示唆。
